title: A-eye contracts v1 + v2
description: Source of truth for every message between A-eye modules. Change only by PR with a version bump. Coordinates are normalized 0..1 of the frame that was sent. bbox is [x, y, w, h] from the top-left corner. v1: the PC-build step flow on WS /ws. v2: the multi-purpose see, point, draw, talk agent on WS /ws2. v1 stays supported.

item.description: Closed set of parts A-eye will guide. Anything else gets the fixed refusal line (safety gate).

hello.description: Client to server, first message on WS /ws.

project_open.description: Client to server: load a saved build (project memory). Server answers with step + say (welcome back line).

frame.description: Client to server: one live camera frame (1 to 2 fps). Server drops results for frames older than 1.5 s.

photo.description: Client to server: one still photo (photo mode, the floor demo).

confirm.description: Client to server: a button press. power_off is required before any step leaves SAFETY.

user_text.description: Client to server: a typed command or a final STT transcript forwarded by the client.

parts_scan.description: Client to server: photo of part boxes; server answers with parts (user confirms each row).

market.description: Client to server: ask for cheaper or better parts that fit this build.

audio.description: Both ways on WS /ws: 16 kHz mono PCM16 chunk. Mic up, TTS down.

pins.description: Only when level is pin, which requires pin_ok from vision.

overlay.description: Server to client: what to draw on the frame with this seq. Empty boxes means clear.

arrow.description: Optional arrow from the held item to the target, normalized.

say.description: Server to client (and orchestrator to voice): one sentence to show as a caption and speak.

step.description: Server to client: current step and its state machine state.

verdict.description: Server to client: result of checking a step. pass true needs conf >= 0.8 (confidence gate). abstain means the frame was too blurry, glared or stale to judge.

parts.description: Server to client: parts read from a parts_scan, each to be confirmed by the user.

market_results.description: Server to client: the market_response for a market request.

summary.description: Server to client after hang-up: done, failed, what to buy.

annotated.description: Server to client in photo mode: the photo with the arrow and diagram inset drawn on it.

error.description: Server to client: something was refused or failed. code refused_part and power_off_required are safety gate outcomes.

identify_request.description: Server to vision: POST /identify. Closed-set: which item is the user holding.

locate_request.description: Server to vision: POST /locate. Where is this header on the frame.

locate_response.description: pins present only when the grid fit ran. pin_ok is computed in code (residual under threshold AND keyed gap found), never by a VLM. found false means not visible.

others.description: Other headers seen in the frame (drawn grey, or red when the user aims at them).

verify_request.description: Server to vision: POST /verify. Is the item seated on the right header and pins.

voice_say.description: Orchestrator to voice adapter: speak this. Cartesia receives only the AI's own sentences.

voice_transcript.description: Voice adapter to orchestrator: what the user said.

voice_barge_in.description: Voice adapter to orchestrator: user spoke over utterance_id; TTS already stopped at at_ms.

voice_spoken.description: Voice adapter to orchestrator: utterance finished playing.

part_specs.description: Every field optional. A missing field means unknown, and compat marks it unverified, never fits.

market_query.description: Server to market module: find options in category that fit the owned parts.

compat.description: Decided by market/compat.py in code. status fits only when every rule checked passed and nothing was unknown.

header_table.description: data/boards/<board_id>.json. Hand-checked against the exact board revision; checked_by is required on every header.

fixture.description: true for made-up demo data that is not a real board.

agent_id.description: Which on-screen agent speaks or draws.

pack_id.description: Skill pack. pc_build keeps the v1 safety gate. memory is the calm memory aid (fixed pill line, no dosing).

draw_op.description: One drawing command. Coordinates normalized 0..1 of the frame with seq.

v2_hello.description: Client to server, first message on WS /ws2.

tts.description: server: send audio chunks (Cartesia). browser: client speaks say text.

stt.description: browser: Web Speech API sends user_text. server: client streams v2_audio_in and the server transcribes (Whisper on the GPU box).

camera.description: false: voice only; the server makes no scene calls and attaches no frame.

voice.description: Optional server TTS voice: a Kokoro voice id (af_kore) or cartesia:<voice id>. Unknown ids fall back to the server default.

role.description: call (default): the device that talks. camera: a second device that only streams frames into the call named by pair_code.

pair_code.description: With role camera: the single-use code the call device got in v2_pair. Without it, the camera joins the latest live call of the same signed-in Cloudflare Access identity (remember this phone); a shared token or an open server never qualifies.

rewind.description: true: Rewind on from the start (clips of this call go to TwelveLabs). Default off.

private.description: Private mode for this call: nothing leaves our own machines (local brain, Kokoro voice, server STT, no crops, no Rewind cloud).

cloud.description: Home first: per-call cloud switches. claude = Smarter answers (question + written scene note, sometimes one small close-up); cartesia = Natural voice (reply sentence only); twelvelabs = Video memory search (short silent clips, deleted at call end). Missing: Claude on, Cartesia on, TwelveLabs off (on if rewind). private: all off.

v2_frame.description: Client to server: newest camera frame. The server keeps only the latest one in memory.

v2_user_text.description: Client to server: what the user said (browser STT or Whisper) or typed. final false is an interim result.

v2_barge_in.description: Client to server: the user started talking over utterance_id; the client already stopped playback.

v2_confirm.description: Client to server: a button press (power_off is required by the pc_build pack before guidance).

v2_draw.description: Server to client: drawing commands from one agent for the frame with seq.

v2_say.description: Server to client: one agent's sentence (caption; spoken by the browser when tts is browser). Streaming turns send one say per sentence with the same turn_id and increasing part.

final.description: Streaming: a turn is spoken sentence by sentence; final true on the last part.

v2_audio.description: Server to client: TTS audio for utterance_id, 16 kHz mono PCM16. final true on the last chunk.

v2_agent_state.description: Server to client: drives the on-screen presence. focus is where the agent is looking or pointing.

v2_market_results.description: Server to client: the shopper agent's offers.

scene_request.description: Server to vision: POST /scene. Describe the frame and ground objects; queries are things the brain wants located.

caption.description: true: always return a caption, also when queries are given (keyframe scans).

brain_turn.description: What the brain returns for one turn (server internal, validated before sending). Draw ops may reference scene object ids via target instead of coordinates; the server resolves them.

draw_anchor.description: Real time: the object region this op is attached to. The client tracks this region between server updates and moves the op with it.

v2_metrics.description: Server to client, dev HUD: timings for one turn or frame, in ms.

stt_ms.description: Server STT: final audio received to transcript ready.

tts_ms.description: First spoken clause sent to its first audio chunk.

v2_track.description: Server to client, fast loop (detector at about 10 to 15 fps when available): fresh boxes for anchored objects.

v2_audio_in.description: Client to server when stt is server: mic audio, 16 kHz mono PCM16. The client cuts utterances with a simple voice activity check; final true ends one utterance.

v2_turn.description: Server to client: where a user turn is, sent at once on arrival (stage received, the ack) and at every stage change, so the client never waits silently. at_ms is server time in epoch ms.

stage.description: expert: the talker called the expert model and is waiting for it (detail names the model); expert_done: its answer arrived, timed out (detail) or was cancelled.

text.description: What the server heard (received or after transcribing).

detail.description: Short human reason, for example 'brain slow, trying backup' or 'nothing heard'.

typical_ms.description: Median of the last 5 turns, end of speech to first spoken text.

v2_reply_delta.description: Server to client: reply text as it is generated, before sentences are complete. Display only; v2_say stays the unit for speech.

v2_camera.description: Client to server: camera turned on or off during a session. Off drops the stored frame and stops scene calls.

v2_pair_request.description: Client (call device) to server: ask for a pair code so a phone can join this session as its camera.

kick.description: true: disconnect the phone paired to this call instead of asking for a code. A remembered phone then waits for the next call.

v2_pair.description: Server to the call device: a single-use pair code. Open /agent.html?pair=<code> on the phone, or send hello{role:camera, pair_code} from an app.

path.description: Relative link for the phone, for example /agent.html?pair=ABCD2345&join=<single-use-secret>

v2_pair_status.description: Server to both devices: pairing and camera state. joined and left describe the camera device; rejected and expired go to a camera socket whose code failed.

role.description: Which device this message is sent to.

source.description: Which device the frames come from now.

retry_s.description: Sent to a camera socket that may try again: no call yet for this signed-in identity, the call already has a phone, or the call ended or disconnected it. A phone with 'remember this phone' on reconnects after this many seconds.

v2_rewind.description: Client to server: Rewind switched on or off. On keeps short clips around keyframes and uploads them to TwelveLabs for search; off drops unsent clips.

keep.description: true: keep this call's TwelveLabs videos after the call. Default false: they are deleted when the call ends.

v2_rewind_state.description: Server to client: Rewind status after a switch or upload. notice is the one-line upload notice to show while on.

locked.description: true: LOCAL_ONLY=1 on the server, Rewind cloud cannot be turned on.

v2_rewind_hit.description: Server to client: the call moment that answers a Rewind question. Times are seconds since the call started. sure is false when our own vision did not confirm the object in the frame; objects are boxes on frame_b64, not on the live picture.

v2_rewind_recap.description: Server to client: a Rewind recap of the call from clips already uploaded while Rewind was on. steps are in call order (t_s = seconds since the call started); skipped names typical steps of the current mode that look skipped.

v2_find_item.description: Server to client: where an object was last seen, from the person's local memory across calls. Carries the rewind_hit fields so the same card renders it: frame_b64 is a small crop of the item (never a full frame) and objects box the item on it; t_s is seconds since this call started (negative for an earlier call). live points at the item or its last place in the current view.

t_s.description: Seconds since this call started; negative for an earlier call.

v2_memory_state.description: Server to client: local memory status after a tag or forget. count is the notes kept today; encrypted false means file-system protection only. After "forget that", item and count_item give the memories left about that item.
